node.statement: Theorem 6.2 (First moment of Mix+(GPS)): E[rho_hat_v^lambda] = rho. Proof: By Lemma 5.4, for each lambda, the GPS estimator on the purification is unbiased for the marginal of tau_lambda(rho). Taking partial trace over B and averaging over lambda via Lemma 6.1 gives E[rho_hat_v^lambda] = E_lambda[tr_B((tau_lambda)_1)] = rho.
